title: Enterprise Information Architecture and Page UX Clarity
goal: Make every AegisPT page understandable, consistent, useful, and enterprise-ready for consultants, SMB operators, and enterprise security teams.
scope: Review and correct Dashboard, Intake, Mission Control, Live Agents, Surface/Attack Map, Problems, Custom CVE Library, Findings, Reports, History, Pack Forge, and Settings so each screen has a clear job, accurate counts, consistent design language, useful empty states, accessible navigation, and no mockup/test/developer language in product-facing UI.
generation_reason: The operator reports that multiple pages are old, unclear, inconsistent, or not useful. Existing mockup parity tasks improved parts of the shell but did not close all page-level UX, copy, data-truth, accessibility, and enterprise workflow gaps.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: UX/page clarity only. Do not change runtime safety, approval, pack validation, deployment, or finding schema semantics unless required to correct displayed product truth.

success_criteria: Every page has a documented purpose, primary workflow, empty state, error state, and next action.
Dashboard counts are derived from real scoped data and never show placeholder or nonsense metrics.
History becomes useful for run history, comparison, audit context, and backlog/build-lane visibility where appropriate.
Settings field labels, examples, constraints, and validation copy are clear enough for a new operator.
Navigation does not expose duplicate hidden targets or inaccessible controls to browser/accessibility tests.
All pages use the same typography, spacing, chips, cards, buttons, terminal blocks, and state language.

required_checks: Full page screenshot audit at desktop and narrow viewports
Accessibility/navigation crawl proving no hidden duplicate primary controls and no unlabeled primary actions
acceptance_criteria: A page-by-page UX scorecard under codex/results shows purpose, data truth, broken-control status, clarity improvements, screenshots, and remaining risks.

before_promotion: backlog-152 has completed or been explicitly deferred by the operator.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
